rationale: v1.80.1 already supports JSON backup import in General settings, but an empty installation only exposes Add space. This adds access to the existing importer without a temporary space and protects its asynchronous UI; it is neither a major new backup feature nor a fix of a feature introduced only on this release line.

summary.ru: JSON-копию House Plan можно импортировать прямо с пустого экрана без создания временного пространства.
summary.en: Import a House Plan JSON backup directly from the empty screen without creating a temporary space.
